req.text: A broad, slow river flowing past an earthen bank and moored wooden boats: a steady soft current, small gurgles and swirls along the hulls, water moving against the bank, open air with a light breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.

A busy riverside wharf by day, heard from the bank: footsteps on wooden planks, heavy sacks thudding down, hemp ropes creaking, wooden hulls knocking softly, water lapping, a low indistinct murmur of workers far off. No music, no speech, no engines.

Many people crossing a large arched timber bridge by day: hollow footsteps on thick wooden planks, shuffling cloth shoes, creaking boards, an occasional hoof knock, a river rushing far below, a distant wordless hum of a crowd with no words. No music, no speech, no voices, no engines.

Open farmland in early spring by day: a light breeze over bare fields and leafless trees, swallows twittering, tree sparrows by a farmhouse, a magpie chattering far off, wide quiet open air. No music, no speech, no engines.
A large old wooden boat hull creaking slowly as it shifts against its mooring, one long deep groan of timber, close, dry.
Four separate small river waves slapping against the side of a moored wooden boat hull, hollow wet knocks with short gaps, close, dry.
A thick hemp mooring rope tightening twice around a wooden post under load, creaking and squeaking stretch, close, dry.
One stroke of a long wooden stern sweep oar sculling a heavy river boat: the wooden pivot creaking, the blade swishing through the water, close, dry.
A tall wooden boat mast being lowered: heavy timber creaking and groaning as it tilts, ropes straining, then a dull heavy wooden thud on the deck, close, dry.
Two strong hand-over-hand pulls on a thick hemp rope, the rope rasping and squeaking under tension, close, dry.
A loose horse galloping fast on packed earth, heavy drumming hooves, a snort, outdoors, close, dry.
Three separate strikes of a wooden mallet on the hub of a wooden cart wheel, solid resonant knocks on hard timber, outdoors, close, dry.

Open land by water on a cool early-spring night: still air, a faint breeze, a few frogs croaking far off, very sparse insects, wide and quiet, no summer cricket chorus. No music, no speech, no engines.
Wind through tall leafless trees in early spring: dry twigs ticking and clattering softly, branches creaking, an airy whoosh rising and falling, no leaves, outdoors. No music, no speech, no engines.
A small shallow stream trickling over pebbles and around wooden bridge posts in open country: gentle bubbling and babbling, soft and close, calm air. No music, no speech, no engines.

A strong river current rushing past timber bridge abutments and wooden piles: fast swirling water, eddies gurgling and sucking, a deep steady rush, outdoors, mid distance. No music, no speech, no engines.
Two moored wooden boat hulls bumping together twice, heavy dull wooden knocks with a short grinding rub, close, dry.
A long bamboo punting pole plunged into a river and pushed hard against the bottom from a wooden boat: a splash, bamboo creaking under strain, water dripping, close, dry.
A coiled hemp rope thrown through the air with a soft whoosh, then slapping down onto a wooden boat deck, close, dry.
A very long taut hemp tow rope under heavy strain outdoors, slow creaking and stretching groans, a light twang as it tightens, close, dry.
Several men leaning into a heavy tow rope together: deep rhythmic effort breaths and low wordless grunts, feet scraping on earth, outdoors, close, dry.
Four footsteps in cloth shoes on the plank deck of a floating wooden boat, hollow boomy knocks with a slight creak and faint water slosh under the hull, close, dry.
Two footsteps on a long wooden gangplank between a boat and a bank, the board bending with a springy creak and a hollow knock, close, dry.
Four footsteps in cloth shoes on wet, sticky river-bank mud, a soft squelch and suck as each foot pulls free, close, dry.
A huge timber arch bridge under the weight of a crowd: massive wooden beams creaking and groaning deeply, low knocks in the joints, outdoors, close, dry.
A horse stamping and shifting on a thick timber bridge deck, four hollow hoof knocks on wooden planks, close, dry.
A crowd on a bridge crying out in alarm together, a sudden rising wordless clamour of many voices, outdoors, close, dry, no intelligible words.
A large two-wheeled wooden cart rolling slowly on a dirt road: big wooden wheels crunching grit, the wooden axle creaking and knocking with each turn, no bell, close, dry.
A donkey walking with two heavy wicker panniers of charcoal on a wooden pack saddle: wicker and wood creaking with each step, lumps of charcoal shifting, close, dry.
A mule calling once, a whinny that breaks into a hoarse bray, outdoors, close, dry.
A full wooden water bucket lifted and set down, water sloshing and the bail handle creaking, close, dry.
Open air at the misty edge of a wide plain: a soft steady breeze, a gentle airy hush, very faint distant birds now and then, calm and empty. No music, no speech, no engines.
A porter heaving a heavy grain sack onto his shoulder: coarse hemp cloth rubbing, grain shifting and settling inside, close, dry.
Someone leaning on an old wooden bridge railing: the rail creaks and its post knocks softly, close, dry.
Tall wooden poles lashed together with rope, creaking and knocking softly as a gust pushes them, outdoors, close, dry.
A small wooden wind vane swinging on a squeaky wooden pivot atop a tall pole in a gust, outdoors, close, dry.
Clothes brushing through dry leafless twigs and bare shoots: light scratching and small snapping ticks, close, dry.
A sleeve brushing along dry straw thatch, a reed mat screen and a woven wattle fence: dry rustle, rattle and scrape, close, dry.
Two separate bumps against a free-standing wooden signboard and a stack of leaning poles: hollow wooden knocks and a short rattle, close, dry.
A shoulder bumping a big glazed earthenware storage jar, three separate hollow ceramic thunks, close, dry.
Three footsteps splashing through ankle-deep water at a muddy stream edge, close, dry.
